title: Comparison with the fixed ambient ordinary integral tensor
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l and scheme X, a normalized constructible tensor completion presentation N [def-sf-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation] has a canonical ordinary tensor isomorphism to the fixed pullback tensor calculus. It is the preimage of N.model inverse followed by the fixed K-flat model under fully faithful restriction along the product of the good localizations. tensorPresentationCompletion is its inverse followed by N.comparison. finiteAmbientScalarTensor conjugates N.ordinary by this isomorphism for a finite normalization [def-sf-native-adic-finite-normalization]. finiteIntegralTensorMap is the inverse of this scalar tensor isomorphism followed by EX of tensorPresentationCompletion.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; Stacks 06YS and 07A4. The indicated subargument of the parent finite integral scalar tensor square.

proof.text: The public cochain tensor rigidity theorem makes restriction by q.prod q fully faithful. Use preimageIso on the composite of the two normalized model isomorphisms. Define the transported completion and ordinary scalar comparison by composition; cancellation of the presentation isomorphism proves the finite tensor map factorization. This is an explicit construction using only uniqueness, with no arbitrary data witness.
